clauses.quote: No matter shall be entertained as a grievance at any step, unless it has been raised with the other party within fourteen (14) school days after the Teacher or the WTU first learned of its cause.
All time limits set forth in this Article may be extended by mutual agreement
clauses.subject_text: All time limits set forth in this Article
clauses.notes: Split from compound sentence joined by 'but'.

clauses.quote: but if not extended, must be strictly observed.
clauses.notes: Fragment from compound sentence; subject carries over from previous clause.

clauses.quote: If a Teacher or the WTU fails to file a grievance within the time limits specified in these procedures, and DCPS does not object within five (5) school days after receipt of the grievance, its right to object to the late filing is waived.
clauses.notes: Conditional waiver of management's right to object to late filings.

clauses.quote: However in no case may a grievance be filed more than thirty (30) school days after the Teacher or the WTU learned of the event giving rise to it.
If the matter in dispute is not resolved within the period provided for any step, the next step may be invoked.

clauses.notes: Split from clause beginning with 'except that'.

clauses.quote: the Grievant may delete items from the grievance.
clauses.notes: Split from clause beginning with 'except that'.

clauses.quote: If the WTU is not a party to Steps 1 or 2 of this Article, then the disposition of the dispute shall not be a precedent with respect to it.
clauses.notes: Rule of construction regarding precedential value; no direct grant or duty.

clauses.quote: No hearing shall be open to the public unless all parties agree.

The fact that a grievance is filed by an employee, regardless of its disposition, shall not be recorded in the employee's personnel file, any file or record used in the promotion process, for any recommendation for job placement;
clauses.subject_text: The fact that a grievance is filed by an employee, regardless of its disposition
clauses.notes: Split at semicolon. Anti-retaliation rule protecting employee records.

clauses.quote: nor shall an employee be placed in jeopardy or be subject to reprisal for having pursued this grievance procedure.
clauses.notes: Split at semicolon. Explicit anti-retaliation guarantee.

clauses.quote: Any hearing provided for in this Article shall be conducted at a time and place which will afford a fair and reasonable opportunity for all persons, including witnesses, required to attend.
clauses.subject_text: Any hearing provided for in this Article

clauses.quote: Witnesses shall be present in the hearing only when their testimony is presented.
clauses.notes: Controls hearing procedure to prevent witness intimidation.

clauses.quote: When hearings are held during school hours, employees required to be present shall be excused with pay for that purpose.
clauses.notes: Pay protection for mandatory hearing attendance during work hours.

clauses.quote: The Parties to this collective bargaining agreement agree that either Party may present witness testimony using video conferencing technology at Step 2 and/or arbitration Hearing that are not related to a Teacher’s suspension or dismissal.
clauses.notes: Joint permission for remote testimony in standard grievances.

clauses.quote: Arbitrations related to a Teacher’s suspension or dismissal require written mutual consent for the use of video conferencing technology.
clauses.notes: Mandates strict consent requirements for serious disciplinary arbitrations.

clauses.quote: Not withstanding the foregoing, mutual written consent for video testimony will continue to be required for all outstanding grievances at the time of ratification and grievances filed within less than 90 days following ratification.
clauses.subject_text: mutual written consent for video testimony
clauses.notes: Transitional provision maintaining prior tech-restriction rules for pending/early cases.
